hook.where: runner.Runner._episode_loop: after _scope and metrics.fetch, before the empty-scope stop and policy.choose
hook.target: candidates with reasons[id] == 'processability:unresolved_ruling' and non-empty input_stages
hook.request: inputs on the actor's own endpoint with the same fetch's game, revision and candidate id
never: writes to trace, actor_logs, metrics, coverage, counters, anomalies

failures.refusal: record status refused; game continues; not a runner anomaly
failures.contract_unknown: record status contract_unknown; continue; not an API_CONTRACT_UNKNOWN stop
failures.Exception: recorder failure; stop recording for this game; game continues; summary failed; batch stops after the game

reconciliation: per game: offered == sum over keys (1 + repeats) + skipped_cap occurrences; record_keys == fetched + skipped_cap keys
batch: sum each game's summary once (iterate the kind set once); totals equal the per-game sums
acceptance_tests: A1 on/off same action and contract digests, choices, outcomes, counters, metrics
A3 handles, updates, log positions, state object unchanged
A7 save, required files, hashes, COMPLETE, resume
A8 no secrets in public outputs
A10 face_down options keep no card_id
interference_conditions: wall time counts toward Limits.seconds and batch budget; games near limits may end differently
_lookup purges stale handles only if the state object changed between fetch and the record request
exceptions from the record request are caught as recorder failure (game continues)
